title: Letter and Lantern
author: Kestrel Blackwood
blurb: Bram Vane, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
